name: Card database
description: Every Magic card on your PC from Scryfall's bulk data (import the file you downloaded, or download it here). Search with filters, pick random cards, build a whole Commander deck around a commander in a play style and themes you pick – see the cards, pick the ones you want or start a new deck with all of them – and add cards as real cards or as your own cards to edit. Decklists look cards up here first.
